name: TestHook
summary: Puts something in production code that exists only for a test, so that behaviour otherwise unreachable can be reached.

roles.name: TestHook
roles.summary: A member the production path never uses. The book offers it as a last resort, and the reason to annotate it is the same as the reason to hesitate: it is code shipped to production for the benefit of a test, and a codebase that cannot list its test hooks has no way to know how much of that it carries.
